meta.why: Removed from the country file: web-checked and confirmed not to be published documents — synthesised meta/framing nodes, geographic areas, industries, projects, institutions. Banned by data spec 2b/2c. Kept here in full so nothing is lost.

reports.title: Iran foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from SCI and CBI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the SCI institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBI institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Iranian research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Iranian research.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Iran nuclear–EAEU–youth densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from energy, trade and labour sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding nuclear power generation (Bushehr), Iran–EAEU free trade framework, and youth unemployment/labour statistics into a coherent energy–external–labour residual layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 10 residual densification.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Power, Russia, BRICS, labour and education series from earlier batches

reports.title: Sanctions and external economic constraints framing
reports.publisher: Derived from CBI, fiscal and international sources
reports.description: Recurring policy and analytical framing of the multi-layered sanctions regime (financial, energy, shipping, secondary sanctions) that constrains oil exports, access to the international financial system, and investment. Continuously cited across macro, fiscal and external analysis.
reports._notes: High-centrality external-constraint frame that conditions almost every major economic series.

reports.title: Iran oil–sanctions–labour densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from petroleum, CBI and SCI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding oil production, oil exports, natural gas statistics, sanctions/external-constraints framing, labour force statistics and poverty/living-standards indicators into a coherent hydrocarbon–constraint–welfare layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the first uniqueness densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, CPI, BOP and CBI series from Batch 1

reports.title: Targeted subsidies and energy-subsidy framing
reports.publisher: Government of Iran / related
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of the large subsidy system (energy, essential goods, cash transfers). Subsidy reform attempts interact tightly with inflation, exchange-rate policy and fiscal sustainability.
reports._notes: High-centrality domestic policy node linking fiscal, energy and welfare.

reports.title: Iran–China merchandise trade and oil sales statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from customs, CBI and shipping sources
reports.description: Bilateral trade with China, with particular emphasis on oil and petrochemical exports. China is the dominant remaining large-scale buyer of Iranian crude under sanctions; non-oil trade is also significant.
reports._notes: Primary bilateral trade corridor under sanctions. China is the key residual oil market.

reports.title: Iran fiscal–exchange–China densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from fiscal, CBI and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding state budget, targeted subsidies, exchange-rate/parallel-market statistics, and Iran–China trade/oil sales into a coherent fiscal–monetary–external layer that interacts tightly with the oil and sanctions nodes from Batch 2.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the fiscal and external densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, sanctions, CPI and BOP series from earlier batches

reports.title: Oil-producing provinces spatial framing
reports.publisher: Derived from SCI provincial and petroleum sources
reports.description: System-level view of the main oil- and gas-producing provinces whose output underpins national hydrocarbon revenues and whose local economies are tightly linked to the energy sector.
reports._notes: Spatial densification of the hydrocarbon cluster.
_referenced_by: Khuzestan GRDP and oil production nodes

reports.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iran / bank disclosures
reports.description: System-wide and bank-level non-performing loan and asset-quality indicators. Asset quality is a recurring concern under high inflation, sanctions and directed-credit pressures.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.
reports._not_a_publication_reason: Grok, agreeing with Claude: CBI pages load but no discrete non-performing-loans (مطالبات غیرجاری) product or series page exists.

reports.title: Iran industry–provincial–banking densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from SCI and CBI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding industrial production statistics, Tehran GRDP, Khuzestan GRDP, oil-producing provinces framing, banking-system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent industry–spatial–financial layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 4 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, fiscal, sanctions and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
reports.description: Estimates of military expenditure. Official figures are affected by high inflation (real declines even when nominal rises) and are widely assessed to understate true spending that draws on off-budget oil revenues.
reports._notes: Core defence-resource node. Interpretation requires care because of off-budget financing.

reports.title: National defence and security policy framing
reports.publisher: Derived from defence and strategic sources
reports.description: Policy and strategic framing of Iran’s defence and security posture, including conventional forces, missile and drone capabilities, and regional influence instruments. Continuously referenced in external and sanctions analysis.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

reports.title: Iran agriculture–defence–education densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from SCI, defence and education sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and wheat production, defence expenditure and policy framing, and education/literacy statistics into a coherent primary-sector, security and human-capital layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 5 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier fiscal, sanctions, labour and poverty series

reports.title: Climate and drought framing
reports.publisher: Derived from meteorological and agricultural sources
reports.description: Policy and analytical framing of climate variability, drought frequency and their impacts on agriculture, water resources and rural livelihoods. Continuously referenced in food-security and adaptation discussions.
reports._notes: Climate-risk densification linked to the water and agriculture clusters.

reports.title: Iran–Russia economic and strategic partnership framing
reports.publisher: Governments of Iran and Russia
reports.description: Economic and strategic partnership framing with Russia, including trade, industrial cooperation, EAEU-related arrangements and broader geopolitical alignment. Complements the China oil corridor as a second major external relationship under sanctions.
reports._notes: Second major external-partner densification after China.

reports.title: Iran health–water–Russia densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from health, water and partnership sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding health/vital statistics, water resources and water-stress indicators, climate/drought framing, and Iran–Russia partnership framing into a coherent health–environment–external layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 6 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Agriculture, sanctions, China and social series from earlier batches

reports.title: Digital economy and e-commerce framing
reports.publisher: Derived from licensing and platform sources
reports.description: Framing and available statistics on digital businesses, e-commerce licensing and online activity. Digital activity continues under constraints on international platforms, payment systems and connectivity.
reports._notes: Digital densification under sanctions-constrained technology and payment conditions.

reports.title: Iran social–petrochemical–digital densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from social, petrochemical and digital sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding social protection and cash-transfer statistics, petrochemical production and exports, non-oil export statistics, and digital/e-commerce framing into a coherent welfare–non-oil–digital layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 7 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, sanctions, poverty and industry series from earlier batches

reports.title: Iran power–mining–provincial densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from energy, mining and SCI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding electricity generation capacity and production, mining/mineral statistics, and the GRDP series for Isfahan, Fars and Bushehr into a coherent energy–mining–further-provincial layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 8 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, industry, Tehran/Khuzestan and energy series from earlier batches

reports.title: BRICS membership and alternative external-architecture framing
reports.publisher: Government of Iran / BRICS related
reports.description: Framing of Iran’s formal BRICS membership (from 2024) as part of an alternative external economic architecture aimed at diversifying partners, reducing dollar dependence and mitigating sanctions constraints. Complements the China and Russia bilateral nodes.
reports._notes: Multilateral external-architecture densification under sanctions.

reports.title: Iran tourism–housing–BRICS densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from tourism, construction and partnership sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding international visitor arrivals, housing/construction permit statistics, and BRICS membership / alternative external-architecture framing into a coherent services–investment–external layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 9 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Services, investment, China, Russia and sanctions series from earlier batches
